name: relu_abs_sub_le
doc: `relu` 的 1-Lipschitz 性（`|relu a − relu b| ≤ |a − b|`，`max` 的 1-Lipschitz）。
stmt: theorem relu_abs_sub_le (a b : ℝ) : |relu a - relu b| ≤ |a - b|
proof:
by
  unfold relu
  exact abs_max_sub_max_le_abs a b 0

name: modReLU_one_half
stmt:
theorem modReLU_one_half :
    modReLU 1 (((1 / 2 : ℝ)) : ℂ) = (((3 / 2 : ℝ)) : ℂ)
proof:
by
  have hz : (((1 / 2 : ℝ)) : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by norm_num
  rw [modReLU_phase_preserved 1 _ hz]
  have habs : Complex.abs ((((1 / 2 : ℝ)) : ℂ)) = (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by
    rw [Complex.abs_ofReal]
    norm_num
  have hr : relu (Complex.abs ((((1 / 2 : ℝ)) : ℂ)) + 1) = (3 / 2 : ℝ) := by
    rw [habs]
    unfold relu
    norm_num
  rw [hr, habs]
  norm_num

name: modReLU_counterexample
stmt:
theorem modReLU_counterexample :
    Complex.abs (modReLU 1 0 - modReLU 1 (((1 / 2 : ℝ)) : ℂ)) = 3 / 2 ∧
    Complex.abs ((0 : ℂ) - (((1 / 2 : ℝ)) : ℂ)) = 1 / 2
proof:
by
  constructor
  · rw [modReLU_zero, zero_sub, modReLU_one_half]
    rw [← Complex.ofReal_neg, Complex.abs_ofReal]
    norm_num
  · rw [show (0 : ℂ) - (((1 / 2 : ℝ)) : ℂ) = (((-(1 / 2) : ℝ)) : ℂ) by norm_num]
    rw [Complex.abs_ofReal]
    norm_num

name: modReLU_not_one_lipschitz_for_pos_bias
doc: **原命题（全 `b` 的 1-Lipschitz）为假**（对 `b = 1` 即被上面的具体反例推翻）。
stmt:
theorem modReLU_not_one_lipschitz_for_pos_bias :
    ¬ (∀ (b : ℝ) (z w : ℂ),
        Complex.abs (modReLU b z - modReLU b w) ≤ Complex.abs (z - w))
proof:
by
  intro h
  have h1 := h 1 0 (((1 / 2 : ℝ)) : ℂ)
  rw [modReLU_counterexample.1, modReLU_counterexample.2] at h1
  norm_num at h1

name: modGain
doc:
门增益 `λ(z) = relu(|z| + b)/|z|`（`z = 0` 时分母为 0，但 `modReLU` 约定为 0，
本定义只在 `z ≠ 0` 时使用）。

name: modReLU_eq_gain_mul
doc: 相位保持的增益形式（`z ≠ 0`）：`modReLU b z = ↑(modGain b z) · z`。
stmt:
theorem modReLU_eq_gain_mul (b : ℝ) (z : ℂ) (hz : z ≠ 0) :
    modReLU b z = ((modGain b z : ℝ) : ℂ) * z
proof:
by
  rw [modReLU_phase_preserved b z hz]
  rfl

name: relu_of_nonneg
stmt: lemma relu_of_nonneg {x : ℝ} (h : 0 ≤ x) : relu x = x
proof:
by
  unfold relu
  exact max_eq_left h

name: modReLU_lipschitz_of_nonpos
doc: **主定理：`b ≤ 0` 时 modReLU 是 1-Lipschitz**。证明见模块 docstring 的路线。
stmt:
theorem modReLU_lipschitz_of_nonpos (b : ℝ) (hb : b ≤ 0) (z w : ℂ) :
    Complex.abs (modReLU b z - modReLU b w) ≤ Complex.abs (z - w)
proof:
by
  set c : ℝ := -b with hc
  have hc0 : 0 ≤ c := by rw [hc]; linarith
  have htb : ∀ t : ℂ, Complex.abs t + b = Complex.abs t - c := by
    intro t
    rw [hc]
    ring
                                  
  have hrev : |Complex.abs z - Complex.abs w| ≤ Complex.abs (z - w) := by
    simpa only [← Complex.norm_eq_abs] using abs_norm_sub_norm_le z w
  by_cases hz : z = 0
  · subst hz
    rw [modReLU_zero, zero_sub]
    rw [show Complex.abs (-(modReLU b w)) = Complex.abs (modReLU b w) from
      Complex.abs.map_neg (modReLU b w)]
    rw [show Complex.abs ((0 : ℂ) - w) = Complex.abs w from by
      rw [zero_sub, Complex.abs.map_neg]]
    by_cases hw : w = 0
    · subst hw
      rw [modReLU_zero]
    · rw [modReLU_magnitude b w hw, htb w]
      exact max_le (by linarith [hc0]) (Complex.abs.nonneg w)
  · by_cases hw : w = 0
    · subst hw
      rw [modReLU_zero]
      simp only [sub_zero]
      rw [modReLU_magnitude b z hz, htb z]
      exact max_le (by linarith [hc0]) (Complex.abs.nonneg z)
    ·                 
      have hrz : 0 < Complex.abs z := by
        rw [← Complex.norm_eq_abs]
        exact norm_pos_iff.mpr hz
      have hrw : 0 < Complex.abs w := by
        rw [← Complex.norm_eq_abs]
        exact norm_pos_iff.mpr hw
      rcases le_or_lt (Complex.abs z) c with hzc | hzc
      ·                           
        have hzneg : Complex.abs z - c ≤ 0 := by linarith
        have hrelu : relu (Complex.abs z + b) = 0 := by
          rw [htb z]
          unfold relu

name: quotient_norm_scale_invariant
stmt:
theorem quotient_norm_scale_invariant (T : (ι → ℝ) → ℝ) (x : ι → ℝ) (α : ℝ)
    (hα : 0 < α) (hT : T (fun j => α * x j) = α * T x) :
    (fun i => α * x i / T (fun j => α * x j)) = fun i => x i / T x
proof:
by
  funext i
  rw [hT]
                                                     
  exact mul_div_mul_left (x i) (T x) (ne_of_gt hα)

theorem rms_is_homogeneous (x : ι → ℝ) (α : ℝ) (hα : 0 ≤ α) :

name: rmsNorm_scale_invariant_via_family
stmt:
theorem rmsNorm_scale_invariant_via_family (x : ι → ℝ) (α : ℝ) (hα : 0 < α) :
    (fun i => α * x i / rms (fun j => α * x j)) = fun i => x i / rms x
proof:
by
                                
  exact quotient_norm_scale_invariant rms x α hα (rms_is_homogeneous x α (le_of_lt hα))

name: unit_normalize_lipschitz
stmt:
theorem unit_normalize_lipschitz {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (x y : E) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (hx : c ≤ ‖x‖) (hy : c ≤ ‖y‖) :
    ‖(1 / ‖x‖) • x - (1 / ‖y‖) • y‖ ≤ (2 / c) * ‖x - y‖
proof:
by
  have hx0 : ‖x‖ ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    linarith
  have hy0 : ‖y‖ ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    linarith
  have hxpos : 0 < ‖x‖ := by linarith
                                    
  have hnorm : |‖y‖ - ‖x‖| ≤ ‖x - y‖ := by
    simpa [abs_sub_comm] using abs_norm_sub_norm_le x y
                                   
  have hrecip : |1 / ‖x‖ - 1 / ‖y‖| ≤ ‖x - y‖ / (‖x‖ * ‖y‖) := by
    have hcalc : 1 / ‖x‖ - 1 / ‖y‖ = (‖y‖ - ‖x‖) / (‖x‖ * ‖y‖) := by
      field_simp [hx0, hy0]
    rw [hcalc]
    have hdenpos : 0 < ‖x‖ * ‖y‖ := mul_pos hxpos (by linarith)
    rw [abs_div, abs_of_nonneg (le_of_lt hdenpos)]
    exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hnorm (le_of_lt hdenpos)
  calc
    ‖(1 / ‖x‖) • x - (1 / ‖y‖) • y‖
        = ‖(1 / ‖x‖) • x - (1 / ‖x‖) • y + ((1 / ‖x‖) • y - (1 / ‖y‖) • y)‖ := by
          congr 1
          abel
    _ ≤ ‖(1 / ‖x‖) • x - (1 / ‖x‖) • y‖ + ‖(1 / ‖x‖) • y - (1 / ‖y‖) • y‖ := norm_add_le _ _
    _ = ‖(1 / ‖x‖) • (x - y)‖ + ‖((1 / ‖x‖) - (1 / ‖y‖)) • y‖ := by
          rw [smul_sub]
          rw [sub_smul]
    _ = (1 / ‖x‖) * ‖x - y‖ + |1 / ‖x‖ - 1 / ‖y‖| * ‖y‖ := by
          rw [norm_smul, norm_smul]
          rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs]
          rw [abs_of_nonneg (by exact one_div_nonneg.mpr (le_of_lt hxpos))]
    _ ≤ (1 / ‖x‖) * ‖x - y‖ + (‖x - y‖ / (‖x‖ * ‖y‖)) * ‖y‖ := by
          exact add_le_add_left (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hrecip (norm_nonneg _)) _
    _ = (2 / ‖x‖) * ‖x - y‖ := by
          field_simp [hy0]
          ring
    _ ≤

name: rmsNorm_lipschitz
stmt:
theorem rmsNorm_lipschitz {n : ℕ} (x y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) (c : ℝ)
    (hc : 0 < c) (hx : c ≤ ‖x‖) (hy : c ≤ ‖y‖) :
    ‖(Real.sqrt n) • ((1 / ‖x‖) • x) - (Real.sqrt n) • ((1 / ‖y‖) • y)‖
      ≤ (Real.sqrt n * 2 / c) * ‖x - y‖
proof:
by
                             
  have hdiff : (Real.sqrt n) • ((1 / ‖x‖) • x) - (Real.sqrt n) • ((1 / ‖y‖) • y)
      = (Real.sqrt n) • ((1 / ‖x‖) • x - (1 / ‖y‖) • y) := by
    rw [← smul_sub]
  rw [hdiff]
  calc
    ‖(Real.sqrt n) • ((1 / ‖x‖) • x - (1 / ‖y‖) • y)‖
        = Real.sqrt n * ‖(1 / ‖x‖) • x - (1 / ‖y‖) • y‖ := by
          rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg n)]
    _ ≤ Real.sqrt n * ((2 / c) * ‖x - y‖) := by
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (unit_normalize_lipschitz x y c hc hx hy) (Real.sqrt_nonneg n)
    _ = (Real.sqrt n * 2 / c) * ‖x - y‖ := by ring

name: center_norm_le
stmt:
theorem center_norm_le {n : ℕ} (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) :
    ‖z - ((∑ i : Fin n, z i) / n) • (constOne : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))‖ ≤ ‖z‖
proof:
by
  let c : ℝ := (∑ i : Fin n, z i) / n
  let w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) := z - c • (constOne : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
                                    
  have horth : inner w (constOne : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) = (0 : ℝ) := by
    unfold w
    have hz : inner z (constOne : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) = ∑ i : Fin n, z i := by
      rw [EuclideanSpace.inner_eq_star_dotProduct]
      simp [Matrix.dotProduct, constOne]
    have h1n : inner (constOne : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) (constOne : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) = (n : ℝ) := by
      rw [EuclideanSpace.inner_eq_star_dotProduct]
      simp [Matrix.dotProduct, constOne]
    have hc1 : inner (c • (constOne : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))) (constOne : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) = c * n := by
      rw [inner_smul_left]
      rw [h1n]
      simp
    have hc : c * n = ∑ i : Fin n, z i := by
      unfold c
      by_cases hn : (n : ℝ) = 0
      · have hn0 : n = 0 := by exact_mod_cast hn
        subst n
        simp
      · field_simp [hn]
    calc
      inner (z - c • (constOne : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))) (constOne : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
          = inner z (constOne : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) - inner (c • (constOne : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))) (constOne : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) := by rw [inner_sub_left]
      _ = (∑ i : Fin n, z i) - c * n := by
            rw [hz, hc1]
      _ = 0 := by
            rw [hc]
            ring
                
  have hzdec : z = w + c • (constOne : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) := by
    unfold

name: center_lipschitz
stmt:
theorem center_lipschitz {n : ℕ} (x y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) :
    ‖(x - ((∑ i : Fin n, x i) / n) • (constOne : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)))
      - (y - ((∑ i : Fin n, y i) / n) • (constOne : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)))‖
      ≤ ‖x - y‖
proof:
by
                                                   
  have hlin : (x - ((∑ i : Fin n, x i) / n) • (constOne : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)))
        - (y - ((∑ i : Fin n, y i) / n) • (constOne : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)))
      = (x - y) - ((∑ i : Fin n, (x - y) i) / n) • (constOne : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) := by
    ext j
    have hmean : (∑ i : Fin n, x i) / n - (∑ i : Fin n, y i) / n
        = (∑ i : Fin n, (x - y) i) / n := by
      have hsum : (∑ i : Fin n, (x - y) i) = (∑ i : Fin n, x i) - (∑ i : Fin n, y i) := by
        simpa [Pi.sub_apply] using (Finset.sum_sub_distrib : (∑ i : Fin n, x i) - (∑ i : Fin n, y i) = ∑ i : Fin n, x i - y i)
      rw [hsum, sub_div]
    simp [hmean]
    ring
  rw [hlin]
  exact center_norm_le (x - y)

                
                                                             
                                                  
                                          
                                                  
                     

end Lattice
